verdict.rationale: The evidence only glancingly touches this story. Semgrep Code docs list 'Triage findings' as a capability, and findings go to the AppSec Platform for triage and remediation. Semgrep Assistant does AI post-processing to cut noise by about 20%, but nothing documents baselining or suppressing existing findings so only new ones alert. Missing for 10: a documented baseline or diff-aware scan that reports only new findings, inline or rule-level ignore/suppression of false positives, persistent ignore status across scans, and independent hands-on corroboration.
